label: Slack: Send Message
description: Posts a Slack message as the bot, to a channel or as a DM to a user, with text and/or Block Kit blocks, optionally in a thread or scheduled; emits ts, channel and permalink (or scheduledId when scheduled).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs chat:write; a DM also needs im:write.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its id
inputs.description: Destination channel (exactly one of channel / user).

inputs.name: user
inputs.label: Direct message user
inputs.placeholder: Pick a user or paste their id (U...)
inputs.description: DM this user instead (exactly one of channel / user).

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: With blocks present, this is the notification fallback.

inputs.name: blocks
inputs.label: Blocks
inputs.description: Block Kit JSON array (from Slack's Block Kit Builder). Give text and/or blocks.

inputs.name: postAt
inputs.label: Schedule (epoch seconds)
inputs.description: Schedule for this Unix time (up to 120 days ahead) instead of posting now.

outputs.name: channel
outputs.description: Where it landed (the DM conversation id for a user send).

outputs.name: scheduledId
outputs.description: Set only when postAt was given.

then.message: SlackSendMessage '{id}' has both `channel` and `user`. Keep `channel` to post in a channel, or `user` to send a direct message, and remove the other.
